en.update.availableLabel: New version available. Check for updates
en.update.checking: Checking the remote repository for newer releases…
en.update.cooldownNotice: This user-initiated update bypasses pnpm's 24-hour release cooldown (supply-chain protection) and installs the selected version immediately.
en.update.doneDetail: All components are up to date.
en.update.error.link: dsh-web or one of its components uses a local link. Sync the checkout, or remove a standalone link duplicated by the aggregate.
en.update.error.notFound: The dsh-web aggregate package is not installed; nothing to update.
en.update.error.pnpmFailed: The update failed (pnpm exited with code {code}); see the output below.
en.update.error.pnpmMissing: pnpm was not found (tried pnpm / corepack / npx). Install pnpm and restart the app (Windows: npm install -g pnpm or corepack enable; macOS: brew install pnpm or corepack enable).
en.update.error.stale: The update command ran but the installed versions did not change. Likely cause: the pnpm 11/12 minimumReleaseAge gate silently skips releases published less than 24 hours ago. The update command already passes --config.minimum-release-age=0 to override it: from pnpm 12 on, --config accepts kebab-case only (a camelCase key is ignored without any warning), so first check that the pnpm the host runs honours that key; when the override really does not apply, add minimumReleaseAgeExclude (e.g. "@linxin666/*") or set minimumReleaseAge: 0 in pnpm-workspace.yaml under the profile directory (~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>), then run the update again.
en.update.error.timeout: The update timed out and the install process was killed; try again.
en.update.error.verifyFailed: The update command ran but the installed versions could not be verified afterwards (registry probe failed or the install path changed). Inspect the output below, or retry later.
en.update.foundDetail: {name} has a newer release v{version}. Confirm to start the update.
en.update.label: Check for updates
en.update.linkModeDetail: dsh-web or one of its components is installed via a local link and cannot be updated remotely. Latest npm release: {version}. Sync the local checkout, or remove a standalone link duplicated by the aggregate.
en.update.missingDetail: Could not locate the installed dsh-web aggregate package. Install it with: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @linxin666/dsh-web-all
en.update.offlineDetail: The network is unavailable or the update service is failing; try again later.
en.update.releaseUnavailable: Release notes are unavailable for this version; see the GitHub release instead.
en.update.restartHint: Restart dsh web for the new version to take effect: stop it with Ctrl+C in the terminal, then run dsh web again.
en.update.title: Check for updates
en.update.unmounted: The update service is not loaded
en.update.unmountedDetail: The running dsh web process loads a plugin build without the update service; restart dsh web (Ctrl+C, then run dsh web again) and retry.
en.update.updating: Updating {name} to v{version}; this may take 1-2 minutes…
en.update.upToDateDetail: {name} is at the latest version v{version}.
